item.description: Glaukon #870 the Blood-handed of the House of Echion fell (vengeance). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Glaukon has drunk from Lethe 3 times and remembers little.

item.description: Glaukon #870 the Blood-handed and Thraskles #8977 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget. Glaukon has drunk from Lethe 3 times and remembers little.
